title: Governance Architecture for Autonomous Agent Systems: Threats, Framework, and Engineering Practice
why_relevant: Proposes a governance architecture for agent systems that includes RAG poisoning as one of three threat classes, with a benchmark and judge-based interception evaluation.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on agent execution-layer governance (sandboxing, tool-call authorization), not RAG robustness specifically; RAG poisoning is only a small slice of the threat model.
